issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

apiKey.description: Pendo API key that is used to initialize the Pendo client

integrationKey.description: Pendo Integration key used for integrations with other products and REST API calls

generalOnboardingGuideId.description:
Id of the Pendo guide to show in the interactive onboarding tutorial
If none is specified, the "Start Tutorial" will not be rendered.

title:
Configuration of Pendo.

To configure:
cfg = Genai.Pendo.Config.inst().getConfig()
cfg.setConfigValue('apiKey', '<API_KEY>')
cfg.setSecretValue('integrationKey', <INTEGRATION_KEY>)
